headline: Caught 2 of 2 confirmed discrepancies; 0 false flags in 2 scored negative comparisons.
limitations: This is a small partially adjudicated sample, not population accuracy. Reviewing all 20 listings does not make all their claims verifiable.
Fourteen definitive field comparisons cover seven listings; the other 13 listings have only unverifiable judgments. Thirty-seven unverifiable field comparisons are excluded from scored denominators.
Ten independently matching field labels had no scored matching prediction and are abstentions, not true negatives.
Six additional emitted flags remain unresolved; they are not counted as either correct detections or false positives.
Unit-specific field names are preserved. They are not mapped onto unscoped whole-listing findings.
The engine remains pinned to commit 68f1c5be5336ff9a55285903d81d2b71b46e779a; this artifact does not measure subsequent source or classifier changes.
No Google Cloud Vision or Parallel evidence was available in this run; their checks are unverifiable.
Listing-source observations and EPC certificate values do not establish a chronological price change.
Missing certificates, expired certificates, uncertain unit identity and unsupported EPC fields remain unverifiable; null reference URLs are preserved.
method: Blind manual comparison of sampled listing source statements against exact-address official EPC certificate pages. Labels record only directly comparable claimed fields; absent or ambiguous evidence is not a negative. Additional blind adjudications cover the remaining 16 sampled listings. Source keys and exact field scopes are normalized without consulting predictions; no duplicate or conflicting comparison keys were found. Provenance files are hashed above. The original frozen selection metadata is retained; current label coverage is reported separately.
